messages.text: Hello, I’m waiting for an email to roll my 2 bitaxe gammas into 1 BC04 miner and pay the $81 difference but I haven’t received anything.

Sorry you're still waiting on that. Let me pick it up here.

What's the order number, or the email on the order? Either one gets me to it, and I can check where the swap stands and get the invoice for the $81 difference moving.
Handed to the team · Two lines must merge into one item at a price the team already committed to in w

I'm sorry, you've been waiting on that far too long. You're right, nothing has gone out yet: the two Bitaxe Gamma 602 lines are still open on Shop····, and the NerdQaxe++ was delivered back on August 31.

Rolling two lines into one BC04 at the $81 you were quoted has to be done by hand, so I've pinged the team to make the edit and send that invoice. Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will come in here, and it also goes to your email.

Thanks for sticking with it. They're on now, so it shouldn't be long.

One thing worth knowing while you wait: the BC04 is a pre-order, it ships by October 29, and you can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Good. I'll keep this open until they're in.
